note: F-115 / R30 route A. unlock(p) asserts ecAdd(ecMulGen(n - 7), ecMulGen(7)) === p. The always-on EC optimizer rewrites that ecAdd twice on the same binding: ec-mulgen-add fuses it to ecMulGen(0), and ec-mulgen-zero then folds it to the 64-zero-byte point at infinity. The TS tier used to stop after the first rewrite (single pass) and emit a runtime ecMulGen(0); the other six tiers ran to a fixed point. Before the TS fix the six native tiers already emitted these exact bytes (sha256 of the hex 54b126fe...fcc3, measured in remediation-logs/F-115/repro/head-foldoff), so the golden is the peers' independent answer, not TS's own. Every spend below executes the fixture's actual compiled locking script on @bsv/sdk Spend: (n - 7)G + 7G = nG = O, so only the all-zero point is accepted.
